name: Tamika
source:
It's t's not easy being a [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Gangrel_(VTM)]Gangrel[/url] in the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla[/url]. 
Ever since the clan unofficially quit the sect at the turn of the century, its members had to choose their loyalties carefully. 

For Tamika, a restless soul born on the West Coast but [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Embrace_(VTM)]Embraced[/url] on the East, a grace period was ensured by her lineage - she is the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Childe]childe[/url] of [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Jezebelle]Jezebelle[/url], a noted member of the Clan of the Beast in New York City. 

This time is coming to an end, however. With her [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Sire]sire[/url] having moved on from the city some years ago, Tamika will now have to decide her own path. 

On the one hand, the Ivory Tower offers nominal safety at the cost of dignity; on the other, the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Anarchs]Anarchs[/url] promise freedom, at the price of having to constantly watch your back. The choice is tough, and it seems there is no simple answer.

[From the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook[/url]]
